# COSLUS

> COSLUS is a professional beauty and oral care brand specializing in innovative water flossers, electric nail care systems, and sonic facial cleansing devices with free shipping and 2-year warranties.

COSLUS offers a curated catalog of rechargeable beauty and dental care tools designed for at-home professional-grade treatments. The product line includes cordless water flossers with multiple pressure modes, electric manicure/pedicure kits, and advanced facial cleansing brushes with various attachments.

## Key Topics

- Water Flosser
- Oral Care
- Dental Care
- Nail Care
- Electric Nail Drill
- Facial Cleansing Brush
- IPX7 Waterproof
- Rechargeable

- Teeth Cleaning
